messages:
Elaine: hey — I accepted the GitHub org invite but when I go to the org page I don't see any repos and trying to clone gives `Permission denied (publickey)`. I ran `ssh -T git@github.com` and got:
```
Permission denied (publickey)
```
Anyone know what I'm missing?
Mohit: did you accept with your work email or personal? If your SSH key is tied to a personal account that doesn't have org access you'll hit that. Can you paste output of `ssh -vT git@github.com` (redact keys).
Elaine: I accepted on my work email, but I do have an old personal GH account with the same display name. ssh -vT shows `Offering public key: /Users/elaine/.ssh/id_rsa` then `Authentications that can continue: publickey` then `Permission denied (publickey)`.
Jordan: sounds like your SSH key isn't uploaded to the work account. On GitHub go to Settings -> SSH and GPG keys. Also check Settings -> Emails to confirm your work email is listed and verified.
Elaine: my work email is listed and verified, and the SSH key is only in my personal account (whoops). If I add the key to the work account will SSO break anything?
onboard-bot: Note: Redwood-org requires SAML SSO for org access. Adding an SSH key to a GitHub account does not bypass SSO — you'll still need to authenticate the account with SSO to get org repo access.
Mohit: correct — add the key to the account that is actually a member of the org (the one that accepted the invite). If your personal account already accepted the invite by mistake, we can rescind and re-invite the correct account. @DevOps SRE can check org membership mapping.
DevOps SRE: pinged — can you DM me your GitHub username? I'll check whether the invite is tied to personal email and fix team membership. If we need to remove the other account we can.
Elaine: thanks — GitHub username = elaine-cole. Also one quick thing — I still can't see the `infra` repo even after logging into the correct account.
Jordan: infra repo is restricted to infra-engineering team. Once DevOps SRE confirms you're in the infra-engineering team you should see it.
DevOps SRE: I checked — the invite landed on `elainecole` (personal). I removed that invite and sent a new one to `elaine@redwood.com`. Accept that and then I'll add you to infra-engineering. Also please enable 2FA if you haven't yet — org requires it.
Elaine: got it, accepted the new invite and turned on 2FA. I uploaded my SSH key to the work account and can `git clone` now :tada: Thanks everyone.
Mohit: welcome aboard :wave: — we'll follow up with a short onboarding checklist DM.
